name: claudecharter
description: A one-line progress route under the prompt (or above it, or only in its pane) for orchestrated work: stages and parts ticked off as they finish, with the live subagents, checks and commits beside them, a /charter checklist and an optional PROGRESS.md mirror

placement.title: Route placement
placement.description: Where the route row shows. under: the first row under the prompt, right under the hint line and above claudepeeker's status line (list claudecharter first in CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS). above: a band directly above the prompt, where surveys draw; it yields to them, and ctrl+x ctrl+a collapses it. panel: no row; the route shows only in the /charter pane.

track.title: Track style
track.description: The look of the route's track. heavy: a bold ━ line on a dim ━ track, between ┣ and ┫. line: ━ on a thin ─, between ┠ and ┨. smooth: █ on ░, the edge filling by eighths of a cell. blocks: █ on ░. shade: ▓ on ░. parallelogram: ▰ on ▱. squares: ■ on □. dots: ● on ○. braille: ⣿ on ⣀. ascii: # on - between [ and ], for fonts without these glyphs. The stage markers ◆ ◇ and the heads ► are the same in every style but ascii (+ and >).

trackEnds.title: Track ends
trackEnds.description: The glyphs at the two ends of the track, in every track style. auto: each style's own (heavy ┣ ┫, line ┠ ┨, the block styles ▐ ▌, ascii [ ]). capsule: ◖ ◗, rounded ends coloured like the bar next to them. start-finish: ◉ ◎. tapered: ╺ ╸. half-blocks: ▐ ▌. brackets: [ ]. corners: ｢ ｣. shells: ❲ ❳.

gapBelow.title: Blank line under the row
gapBelow.description: on: one blank line between the route row and what is drawn under it (the other mods' rows under the prompt, or the prompt box when the row is above the prompt). off: the next line sits right under the row.

glide.title: Gliding progress
glide.description: on: when the route moves forward, the progress head ► glides to its new place on the track in about 0.8 s, a short bright trail behind it, instead of jumping; the fill brightens toward the head like a comet. A move back glides without the trail.

roll.title: Rolling counters
roll.description: on: the percent and the stage number roll like an odometer, the digits that change flashing.

activity.title: Live activity
activity.description: on: while a subagent or a test/build command runs, its spinner turns and the current step shimmers; while Claude works, the phase dot breathes and the next stage marker ahead of the head softly pulses.

celebrate.title: Celebrations
celebrate.description: on: a finished step twinkles and shows a short badge, a finished stage sends a gold glint along the track, completing the route pulses the track's caps, and a commit flashes its hash.

toast.title: Stage toasts
toast.description: on: a toast when a top-level stage is done and when the whole route is complete.

nudge.title: Route nudge
nudge.description: on: when the main conversation starts its first subagent and this session has no open route, that call's result carries one fixed line asking Claude to chart a route if the subagent is one step of multi-stage work. Once per session; again after /charter clear or once a route is complete. off: never.

mirror.title: PROGRESS.md mirror
mirror.description: on: keep a markdown checklist of the route in the project (setting Mirror file), rewritten on every change; when several sessions share a route, one of them writes it. The file names its route; the mod never overwrites a file it did not write, or one another live route owns (/charter mirror claim takes it over).

mirrorFile.title: Mirror file
mirrorFile.description: The checklist file the mirror writes, relative to the project root and ending in .md. An absolute path or one with .. falls back to PROGRESS.md.
